Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A Snapshot of Your DayAs a senior software developer on our team, you will design and implement embedded software for our converter control platform, supporting the energy transition. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional team members throughout the entire software development lifecycle???from clarifying requirements and implementing features to testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Working in agile teams, youll contribute to innovative projects and help ensure our solutions are robust, secure, and high-performing.How Youll Make an ImpactDesign, implementation, and verification of software in C++ for embedded systems applications, in close collaboration with the development team. Taking co-ownership of the entire software lifecycle: from requirements analysis, architecture, and documentation to testing and deployment of software solutions.Contributing to code reviews and fostering a culture of best practices and continuous performance optimization within the team.Analyzing and resolving critical issues and supporting customer inquiries.What you bring Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (Bachelors with strong experience also considered)More than 8 years of experience in software development, particularly in operating systems and embedded systems.In-depth knowledge of C++First experience in software architecture, including contributing tot architectural concepts and technical design decisions.Hands-on experience with tools for source code management and build automation such as Git and CMake, as well as adapting CI pipelines.Experience in mentoring and supporting junior developers in their technical development.Ideally, experience with static code analysis.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; excellent English communication.About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. Siemens Energy offers an outstanding range and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and technology related to digital grid technology.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but were also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur OfficeSiemens Energys location in One Cotroceni Park is more than just an office space - its a hub for a vibrant and growing community. Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the perfect place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. And with the Academia Militara subway station just a 3-minute walk away, getting around the city has never been easier.Our Commitment to DiversityLucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character ??? no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.
